answer: Rewards can be capped by trust flow. Picture the network as a graph where each account vouches for a few others, and each epoch at dawn a fixed budget of trust flows outward from long-standing seed accounts. An account earns only as much trust as actually reaches it. A sybil farm can write itself a sonnet of praise with ten thousand internal vouches, but all that flow must still squeeze through the few real accounts that vouched for it, like water seeping through shale, so a thousand fakes split the same thin trickle one would get.
